column2: `GC.config[:implementation]` is `"metorex"`, where MRI answers `"default"`, since Metorex frees an object when the last reference to it goes.
Answers nil for a thread waiting its turn, since every Metorex thread runs on the one operating system thread the interpreter runs on.
